name: Read AI
summary: Meeting notetaker that joins calls as a bot for summaries, action items and coaching metrics, with search across email and chat.

evidence.quote: Always free, no credit card required.

trainingDefault.quote: Read AI does not train on customer data by default. This is the default state for every user.

trainingControl.quote: You may choose to opt-in or opt-out at any time, via your account settings.

subprocessorTraining.quote: Third-party AI tools are not permitted to use any user data collected via Google Workspace APIs

dpa.quote: We have appointed Adam Brogden of GDPRLocal Ltd. as our EU and UK representative under Article 27, GDPR.

adminEnforcement.quote: We do not offer admin-only licenses

caveats.text: Privacy policy says Read may use information to train and improve its models within its services, consistent with account settings.

evidence.quote: using information to train and improve our models within our Services

caveats.text: Audio and video are stored per internal policy, for no longer than 2 years.

evidence.quote: in no case for longer than 2 years
